newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish H1 trade balance up to 16.6 bln DKK.
newsitem.headline: Danish H1 trade balance up to 16.6 bln DKK.

text.p: Denmark's trade balance, excluding ships, rose to a surplus of 16.631 billion crowns in the first half of 1996, compared to 13.371 billion in the same period last year, the national statistics office said Tuesday.
Seasonally adjusted the figures were 16.719 billion for the first six months of 1996 and 13.881 for January-June 1995, the office added.
The June surplus, excluding ships, was 2.734 billion, down from both May 1996 and June 1995 and below analysts' expectations. --Uffe Hansen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969658
